title: His present booking: California Malibus, The Joker Is Wild and ABC
summary: He books the self-contained California Malibus and an Oklahoma City group, and works occasionally with Associated Booking.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: They showed up late and probably played badly. Incidentally, you don't book regularly now. Who is the group you have now?
The California Malibus. It's a vocal group, but it's self-contained, they have a band.

Now I'll tell you one of the things that I just really hope they (inaudible), I've had them before. They're sensational, but they (inaudible) and half the time won't pay the musicians and the musicians walk out on them, but now I think the musicians are in with them, so if they hold out on that, we will really do some money. I have them for four weeks in

And there's another group, The Joker Is Wild. I think you might have noticed a little yellow sheet in the book. It's a very nice group, self contained, but any kind of notice--some of them have jobs, but they have an understanding like I used to have when I was in the electric shop, if you give them a week's notice, they can go out and be out.
So in other words, they have part time jobs?

Yeah, yeah, that's it. That's a very good group, we'll see if we can do something for them. They're out of Oklahoma City. This California Malibus go anywhere, and that's the only one that I am doing. And then once in a while, Alexander, we're still uptight, and also ABC,
they'll contact if they're kind of stuck, like ABC, Associated Booking, had me working on something for Bobby not long ago.
Bobby Bland. Naturally I'm kind of close to them because of Junior, he was there for so long.
That's right, Junior had the band. My present drummer (inaudible).
